units.source_text: 我的推测果然没有错。

en.t: My guess had indeed not been wrong.

units.source_text: 不过，我只是想象了爱情的一个侧面。

en.t: However, I had only imagined one side of love.

units.source_text: 在先生美好的爱情背后还有着可怕的悲剧，

en.t: Behind Sensei's beautiful love there was also a terrible tragedy,

units.source_text: 那个悲剧对于先生来说，是多么地惨痛，夫人却全然不知，

en.t: and his wife knew absolutely nothing of how painful that tragedy was for Sensei,

units.source_text: 至今依然一无所知，先生是将此事瞒着夫人死去的。

en.t: even now she still knows nothing, for Sensei died keeping it hidden from her.

units.source_text: 先生在毁掉夫人的幸福之前，首先毁灭了自己的生命。

en.t: Before destroying his wife's happiness, Sensei first destroyed his own life.

units.source_text: 关于这个悲剧，我现在什么也不想说。

en.t: About this tragedy, I do not wish to say anything now.

units.source_text: 由于这一悲剧而产生的他们之间的爱情，正如前面说过的，

en.t: As I said before, the love between them that arose from this tragedy

units.source_text: 他们都没有对我提起过。

en.t: was something neither of them ever mentioned to me.

units.source_text: 夫人是由于谨慎起见，先生则有着更深的缘由。

en.t: His wife kept silent out of caution, while Sensei had a deeper reason.

units.source_text: 只有一件事还留在我的记忆中。

en.t: Only one thing remains in my memory.

units.source_text: 那是个樱花盛开的时节，我和先生一同到上野公园去赏花。

en.t: It was the season when the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, and I went with Sensei to Ueno Park to view the flowers.

units.source_text: 在那里，我们看见一对漂亮的情侣，

en.t: There we saw a handsome young couple,

units.source_text: 两人情意绵绵地相互依偎着在花下漫步。

en.t: walking beneath the blossoms, leaning tenderly against one another.

units.source_text: 由于是在众目睽睽的公园里，很多去赏花的人都朝他们俩看。

en.t: Because they were in a public park under everyone's gaze, many people who had come to view the blossoms looked toward the two of them.

units.source_text: “他们像是新婚夫妇啊。”先生说。

en.t: They look like newlyweds, Sensei said.

units.source_text: “似乎很恩爱呀。”我附和着。

en.t: They seem very affectionate, I replied in agreement.

units.source_text: 先生连苦笑都没有露出，

en.t: Sensei did not even show a wry smile,

units.source_text: 朝着看不到这对情侣的方向走去，然后问我：

en.t: but walked off in a direction where the couple could no longer be seen, and then asked me:

units.source_text: “你恋爱过吗？”

en.t: Have you ever been in love?

units.source_text: 我回答说没有。

en.t: I answered that I had not.

units.source_text: “你不想恋爱？”

en.t: Do you not want to fall in love?

units.source_text: 我没有回答。

en.t: I did not answer.

units.source_text: “不会不想吧。”

en.t: It cannot be that you do not want to, can it?

units.source_text: “是的。”

en.t: No, it cannot.

units.source_text: “方才看到那对男女时，你嘲笑了人家一句吧。

en.t: When you saw that man and woman just now, you made a mocking remark about them, did you not?

units.source_text: 在你的嘲笑里掺杂着你追求爱情，却又得不到的不快之音。”

en.t: In that mockery there was a note of resentment, because you seek love but cannot obtain it.
